system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: First, the node constructs the LLM prompt through its make_prompt method
system_prompt_style.note: Each node builds its own prompt from the tape at runtime; prompt varies per node/step.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: The QA agent can search the web, run Python code, read multiple file types.
env_context_strategy.note: Context obtained via tool actions; no up-front tree injection found.

observation_format.note: Observations are structured step objects rendered as text; browser/screenshot tools exist in examples but not evidenced here.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: make a comprehensive prompt from all the data from the tape and the possible step schemas, then parse the LLM output using the schemas
tool_call_format.note: Steps are Pydantic JSON objects parsed from LLM text; function-calling configs (gaia_fcalls.yaml) also shipped.

tool_count.note: No single default agent tool list in the evidence.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Action to execute the python code snippet. Can be used to perform calculations, simulations or data processing.
edit_primitive.note: No file-edit tool visible; modifications only via executed code.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: name: str = Field(description="name of the program, lowercase, no spaces, unique, ends with .py")
tool_schema_source.note: Schemas derived from Pydantic Action models; MCP configs shipped (conf/mcp/web_and_code.json).

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: following ReAct (Yao et al., 2023b)+Planning approach, with goal-setting, reflection and acting nodes
loop_primitives.note: agents stream events to the orchestrator (event_driven).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: We build the QA agent from MonoNode nodes, with two planning nodes and one acting node
planning_granularity.note: Plans are thought steps on the tape, not a separate plan object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The agents are organized in hierarchical teams, with one agent being active at a time.
multi_agent_topology.note: Default agent is one root agent with nodes; hierarchical teams reachable via subagents.

delegation_mechanism.note: Default subagents list is empty; role_handoff via Call/Respond delegation reachable.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: self._chat.add_message(role="assistant", msg=f"Requesting permission to run the code(Y/n):\n\n{code}")
human_in_loop.note: CodeExecutorWithApproval is opt-in; default CodeExecutor does not ask.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: an agent framework built around a granular, structured log (tape) of the agent session that also plays the role of the session's resumable state

long_term_memory.note: MemoryTool with LocalMemoryStorage persists across runs; opt-in (conf/use_memory.yaml).

state_persistence.evidence_quote: To resume, one can just restart the orchestration from an intermediate tape.

self_verification.evidence_quote: There is a lot of room for further improvement of the agent, starting from the obviously beneficial majority voting ensembling of runs and up to the multiagents, self-critic techniques
self_verification.note: Self-critic listed as future work; annotator/scorer exist for eval, not in-loop.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: When a node produces an action, the agent stops and returns a new tape with the generated steps from all iterations appended to it.
retry_policy.note: No task-level retry in the run loop evidence.

rollback.evidence_quote: The environment.react searches for the unfulfilled actions in the tape and adds the corresponding observation steps to the tape.
rollback.note: No undo/revert mechanism in evidence; tape can be restarted from an earlier point.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: max_iterations (int): The maximum number of iterations the agent will execute before stopping.

cost_controls.note: LLM call caching; TAPEAGENTS_FORCE_CACHE also available.

timeouts.evidence_quote: timeout (int, optional): The timeout for code execution. Defaults to 60.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: A code executor class that executes code through a command line environment in a Docker container.
execution_isolation.note: CodeExecutor executes code in a container; CodeExecutorWithApproval uses host subprocess.

network_policy.note: No network option passed at container creation; web search tools require egress.

permission_model.note: Language execution policy allows/denies by language.

tracing.evidence_quote: We store the prompt and the output for all LLM calls in an SQLite database.
tracing.note: Tape itself is a structured per-step log.

replayability.evidence_quote: For testing purposes, one can run an agent with replayed observations and LLM outputs and verify that this process leads to the same tape or print the diff otherwise.

eval_hooks.note: Eval/scorer scripts ship in examples of the pinned repo.

target_domain.evidence_quote: does planning, searches the web and uses code interpreter

open_source.note: LICENSE + NOTICE ship at repo root; licence text not quoted in evidence.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: For an in-depth understanding of the design principles, architecture, and research behind TapeAgents, see our technical report

first_release_date.note: Basis: paper v1 date; no tag list in evidence.
